candidates.claim: sw-it-01 vty lines 0 4 have transport input telnet and ssh, so Telnet is enabled, which the management policy forbids on every device.
candidates.remediation: Remove telnet from the transport input of vty lines 0 4 on sw-it-01 so that only ssh remains.

candidates.claim: The transport input of line vty 0 4 on sw-it-01 differs from the approved baseline: the baseline allows ssh only, while the current configuration allows telnet and ssh.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this sw-it-01 vty 0 4 transport input change with the approved baseline and revert it to ssh only unless the change is approved.

candidates.claim: VLAN 10 is allowed on trunk ports sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 and sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/24, which are not OT-facing access ports, so the rule that only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10 may not hold for these uplinks.

clarifications.question: Only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10, but the approved trunks sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/24 {10,99} and sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 {10,99} carry VLAN 10 on ports that are not in the OT-facing port roles. Does the approved trunk list override the 'only OT-facing ports' rule for these uplinks, or should VLAN 10 be limited to the OT-facing access ports?
